validation_scope: energy/state/finite-window stationarity at this grid and domain only

model_assumptions.reference: BEM E1, 30 x 30 mm suspended film, mean Joule power 1.13 W
model_assumptions.frequency_interpretation: chosen electrical 10 kHz / acoustic 20 kHz; paper generator setting unresolved
model_assumptions.heat_capacity_provenance: assumed 7e-4 J/(m2 K), not reported by the BEM paper
model_assumptions.viscosity_provenance: inherited project air baseline, not reported by the BEM paper
model_assumptions.name: e1_power_f20000_r4

mapping.heat_flux_tau32_relation: alpha_lu = theta_transport_lu * (tau32 - 0.5); local heat-flux retention = 1 - 1/tau32; local conductive readout = 1 - 1/(2*tau32); not independent transport knobs
mapping.heat_flux_scale_definition: q_phys = q_lu * rho_scale * (dx_m/dt_s)^3; exported q_lu is conductive heat flux after the local pre-collision readout factor 1 - 1/(2*tau32)
